title: Hoisted token system and adaptive card-sheets consistency audit
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Audit and refactor of console visual tokens and a new adaptive card-sheet component pattern. Goals: hoist shared tokens into the top-level token registry (color, elevation, spacing, motion) to reduce duplication and ensure consistent rollouts; design a responsive 'card-sheet' pattern for metric/dashboards that adapts between dense grid, single-column mobile, and 'rail' mode for narrow consoles; produce Figma library assets, specs, and a short prototype for PM/Eng validation.
acceptance_criteria: Top-level token registry exported in Figma with clear naming and paired platform token mapping (CSS vars + token aliases)
Card-sheet component variants covering three breakpoints: compact grid, standard card, and rail mode — documented with usage guidance
Rollout states documented (canary, active, fallback) with token overrides and recommended transition animations
Design spec includes accessibility contrast checks, focus states, and keyboard interactions for card actions
Link to Figma library, prototype, and a short QA checklist created for visual regression tests
comments: 2026-02-21 — Sofia Patel: Kickoff meeting with PM and frontend. Agreed scope: tokens + card-sheet + rollout state spec. Eng to investigate existing token collisions (ENG-81234).

2026-02-25 — Jordan Lee: Initial hoisted token draft created in Figma. Replaced duplicated elevation tokens with elevation-100..900 scale. Posted RFC: https://confluence.redwood/team/design/token-hoisting-2026

2026-03-01 — Design review: Ran into a trade-off between semantic token names (surface-primary) and platform-mapped names (bg-01). PM prefers semantic for product clarity; Eng prefers platform for implementation stability. Agreed to provide both mappings in the library.

2026-03-03 — Prototype update: built interactive card-sheet prototype for breakpoints (Figma Prototype). Performance note: long lists should flip to virtualized rails — Eng follow-up assigned ENG-81234.

2026-03-06 — Accessibility pass: adjusted text tokens for small caps and microcopy to meet AA at narrow sizes. Documented contrast failures for a deep-purple accent on dark backgrounds and recommended swap to accent-emerald-600.
2026-03-08 — PM review (Ava Murphy): asked for rollout examples showing canary -> 50% -> full with token overrides and rollback path. Added rollout token snippet and change log examples.

2026-03-10 — Jordan Lee: Prepared Figma library export and submitted PR for component spec (github.com/redwood/console-design/pull/1247). Requesting frontend review and scheduling visual regression test next cycle.
design_links: Token mapping table (CSV): drive link in attachments
Rollout examples: Confluence rollout patterns section
notes: Implementation note for Eng: provide token aliases as both CSS variables and JS tokens; include a legacy mapping table to ease migration.

Follow-up: Create a short snippet for Console Optimize to recommend token/quantization pairings for cost-sensitive surfaces (low contrast surfaces should avoid heavy shadows to reduce rendering costs on thin clients).
Risk: Changing base spacing tokens affects many dashboards; schedule a migration window and a feature flag for rollout.
Next steps: 1) Frontend review of PR, 2) Add visual regression snapshots to the CI job, 3) Prepare release notes for console-2026.03
